task: FP-A01 wallet reconciliation coverage and active-read guard repair

current_state.wallet_summary: walletReconciliationStatus accepts the latest run containing any target source and can report matched without complete or unique coverage
current_state.cutover_assessment: walletCutoverReconciliationStatus already checks missing and duplicate required sources during initial assessment
current_state.active_runtime: getRuntimeWalletView checks projection, pending attempts, capacity and shadow but does not re-evaluate reconciliation after activation
current_state.persistence: reconciliation runs are persisted in the existing domain snapshot and restored from SQLite

similar_patterns: walletCutoverReconciliationStatus computes a deterministic required-source set and fails closed on missing or duplicate entries
getRuntimeWalletView derives stable blockers and returns read_balance=null without fallback when an active Local cutover is unhealthy
FP-06b restart tests reopen the same SQLite file and validate append-only cutover generations and restored domain state
observations: Opening balances and internal corrections are ledger facts but do not require Provider reconciliation and must not permanently block a wallet scope
Required external sources are settled/refunded payments, confirmed refunds, posted collections and provider fees for the target LedgerAccount and currency
A reconciliation item must not satisfy coverage when its amount currency is absent or differs from the requested accounting currency
A new exception or unknown reconciliation run can appear without changing financial Posting, so projection freshness and shadow equality do not imply reconciliation health

questions.question: Which facts require reconciliation for a wallet scope?
questions.answer: Only externally reconcilable settled/refunded payments, confirmed refunds, posted collections and provider fees bound to the target LedgerAccount and accounting currency.

questions.question: How should partial, duplicate, unknown or malformed evidence affect runtime reads?
questions.answer: A shared strict evaluator returns incomplete, exception, unknown or not_observed; an active Local cutover becomes blocked with read_balance=null and new reserve fails before Adapter invocation.

questions.question: How does recovery avoid another payment?
questions.answer: Recovery appends a newer complete reconciliation run; no Transaction, Posting, wallet or Adapter operation is rewritten or repeated.

questions.question: Does this require Schema or API migration?
questions.answer: No. The change reinterprets existing reconciliation run items using fields already persisted by F14 and adds compatible diagnostic fields to internal read models.
